connector.name: Simmer
connector.registryDescription: Trade prediction markets with AI agents - skill discovery, autoresearch, and execution.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package simmer-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the adlai88 account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SIMMER_API_KEY
env.description: Simmer API key (sk_live_...) from simmer.markets/dashboard. Required for Pro tools (autoresearch, trading, briefings). Free tools work without it.

env.name: SIMMER_MCP_ALLOW_LIVE
env.description: Set to 'true' to allow live trading via simmer_trade. Without this, all trades run in paper/sim mode.
